profile_policy: Retain NCURR=1 and full QA pressure/current coefficients and amplitudes; iota is solved, never prescribed through AI.
boundary_family: R=R0+a*cosh(t)*cos(theta)+a*sinh(t)*cos(theta-h*NFP*phi); Z=a*cosh(t)*sin(theta)-a*sinh(t)*sin(theta-h*NFP*phi), h in {-1,+1}, a=R0/5. No other boundary harmonics.
stage2_policy: Refit the new fixed WOUT with 111 DOFs. Require geometry and VC quadrature checks and actual frozen NESTOR DEL-BSQ <= 0.01 before releasing boundary; normal-field errors remain reported diagnostics under user-approved 1 percent gate.
angular_resolution_policy: 48 full poloidal by 40 toroidal per field period for every fixed/free radial stage and coil target evaluation; VC integration quadrature is separately converged.
